transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Okay, let's go. Short one, I've got the review at nine.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Go.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Dyno first. Andre.

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: knee unit from last night tripped again, same overcurrent fault, same spot in the profile. like right at the stair-climb segment

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: i pulled the logs, havent looked at the encoder data yet

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Drive or the unit?

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: dunno yet. im swapping the drive this morning, if the fault follows the drive we know

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Fine. Do that before anything else.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Thermal. We're still cooking the motor on the long holds. I need the heat spreader, ten of them, by 10/1. Question is whether it's worth paying to expedite or we just, uh, eat the wait.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: i mean if the holds are the only thing blocked we could cut the hold profile short till they land? not sure it tells us much tho

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: It tells us nothing. Short-hold thermal data is garbage.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Yeah. I'll ask Gwen what it actually costs and decide today.

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Can I get one of the old spreaders back for the fit check? I gave mine to Luis 😬

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: its on the bench by the arbor press, the one with the tape on it

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: blue tape, not the red

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Also 2124. Need three by 9/29. That one's not optional!!

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Three by the twenty-ninth. Got it.

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Sorry, sorry. The badge reader on the side door is dead again.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Lin, life test. Quick.

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Ankle rig is about two thirds of the way through the cycle target. Backlash is creeping but still inside the limit. I'll have a plot by end of day.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Creeping how much.

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Small. Roughly linear since the weekend. I don't want to call it until I see the next block.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: fixtures, the new clamp plate for the hip rig is cut, just waiting on deburr. should be on the rig thurs. maybe fri actually

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: i can deburr it today if nobody needs me on the line after 10

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: You're on the line till lunch. After.

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: ok after lunch

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: hey sorry was at the dock truck came early

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Anything for us?

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: couple boxes for test mostly fasteners and some cable stuff ill put them on the shelf by inspection

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: did the torque transducer come back from cal?

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: didnt see it

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: ok ill chase it

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Two more on the list. FL-TST-2136, need two by 9/30. And FL-ANK-1244, seven of those by 10/2.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: sorry 2136 by when?

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: 9/30. The thirtieth.

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Seven of the ankle ones, ok, putting it on the whiteboard 🙏

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Who's on the overnight soak tonight?

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: me. ill set it up before i leave

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: I'll check it when I get in.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Housekeeping. Somebody left the chamber door open overnight Sunday. Again.

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Wasn't me 😅

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: I'll print a sign for the door.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: also the coffee machine is doing the grinding noise again

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: its been doing that for weeks lol

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Not our problem. Andre, drive swap. Lin, plot. Zoe, clamp plate. I'll sort the expedite question. Done.

summary.overview: Quick standup. Knee unit on dyno still tripping overcurrent at same point in profile, drive swap today to isolate. Motor running hot on long holds while waiting on heat spreaders; Dmitri to decide on expediting. Life test backlash creeping but in limit. Lin and Jade late.

heat spreader x10 needed by 10/1, expedite y/n TBD (Dmitri w/ Gwen)
life test ankle rig ~2/3 thru, backlash creeping, plot EOD
hip rig clamp plate cut, needs deburr, Luis after lunch
torque transducer not back from cal?
